fact: The EU Trust Fund programme (EUR 25 million, started 8 May 2017) aims at a computerised civil status information system linked to a biometric database, with a central civil status file interconnected with civil registration centres.
title: Programme d'appui au fonctionnement de l'état civil au Mali: appui à la mise en place d'un système d'information sécurisé
publisher: EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa
